context_for_next_testing_agent: Public verify endpoint is fully working. Bug fix confirmed: verify_payslip/public_verify now trust stored slip['kode'] (no recompute). Payslip PDF generation NOT tested (requires Gaji PIN — off-limits per constraints). Backend pytest lives at /app/backend/tests/test_public_verify.py — reusable for regression.
rca of the issue: Original bug: verify endpoint recomputed kode from slip fields (id|period|take_home) via HMAC and compared to input, but stored kode on the actual PDF was generated at a moment where the slip document could subsequently be edited (take_home rounding / re-import), which broke the HMAC match. Fix: both verify_payslip and public_verify now query hrd_payslips/hrd_letters by the STORED 'kode' field directly (source of truth = what was printed on the physical document). Confirmed working for real code 247C-6B9E-5C76.
